arxiv-2101-06505.title: What was the river Ister in the time of Strabo? A mathematical approach Volume: Volume 80, Number 2021, Thanks: Supported by the Grants APVV-19-0460 and VEGA 1/0436/20.
arxiv-2101-06505.creator: Karol Mikula, Martin Ambroz, Renáta Mokošová
arxiv-2101-06505.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Karol Mikula, Martin Ambroz, Renáta Mokošová. In this paper, we introduce a novel method for map registration and apply it to transformation of the river Ister from Strabo’s map of the World to the current map in the World Geodetic System. This transformation leads to the surprising but convincing result that Strabo’s river Ister best coincides with the nowadays Tauernbach-Isel-Drava-Danube course and not with the Danube river what is commonly assumed.

arxiv-2210-04906.title: Template
arxiv-2210-04906.description: Abstract We propose a definition for the Lorentzian Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity path integral that includes Lorentzian topology changing configurations. The construction is inspired by the bosonic string genus expansion on singular Lorentzian worldsheets, with geometries known as lightcone diagrams playing a prominent role.

arxiv-2307-09917.title: Photospheric velocity evolution of SN 2020bvc: signature of r r -process nucleosynthesis from a collapsar emcee ( Foreman-Mackey et al. 2013 )
arxiv-2307-09917.creator: Long Li, Shu-Qing Zhong, Zi-Gao Dai
arxiv-2307-09917.description: Abstract Whether binary neutron star mergers are the only astrophysical site of rapid neutron-capture process ( r r -process) nucleosynthesis remains unknown. Collapsars associated with long gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) and hypernovae are promising candidates. Simulations have shown that outflows from collapsar accretion disks can produce enough r r -process materials to explain the abundances in the universe.

arxiv-2401-10745.title: Ethical Artificial Intelligence Principles and Guidelines for the Governance and Utilization of Highly Advanced Large Language Models
arxiv-2401-10745.creator: Soaad Qahhār Hossain, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed
arxiv-2401-10745.description: Abstract Given the success of ChatGPT, LaMDA and other large language models (LLMs), there has been an increase in development and usage of LLMs within the technology sector and other sectors. While the level in which LLMs has not reached a level where it has surpassed human intelligence, there will be a time when it will.

pmc-11297566.title: Comment on: “Operator gender differences in major mechanical complications after central line insertions: a subgroup analysis of a prospective multicentre cohort study”
pmc-11297566.creator: Jose A Calvache, Markus Klimek
pmc-11297566.description: We read with great interest the recent study by Naddi et al. in BMC Anesthesiology, which explores operator gender differences in major mechanical complications following central venous catheterization. The study identifies male operator gender as an independent risk factor for complications. However, our attempt to replicate these findings using Colombian data did not support this association.

pmc-11411852.title: Postoperative early laboratory changes and follow-up process of patients underwent hyperthermic intrathoracic chemotherapy
pmc-11411852.creator: Sercan Aydin, Seda Kahraman Aydin, Hasan Yavuz, Ayse Gul Ergonul, Tevfik Ilker Akcam, Kutsal Turhan, Alpaslan Cakan, Ufuk Cagirici
pmc-11411852.description: BackgroundThe aim of combining hyperthermic intrathoracic chemotherapy (HITHOC) with surgery is to achieve local control in patients with pleural malignancies. Liver and kidney dysfunction resulting from this procedure have been reported in the literature. The objective of the study is to examine whether the laboratory abnormalities observed during the initial period persist until day 30.

pmc-11603350.title: Use and acceptability of an asthma diagnosis clinical decision support system for primary care clinicians: an observational mixed methods study
pmc-11603350.creator: Luke Daines, Anne Canny, Eddie Donaghy, Victoria Murray, Leo Campbell, Carol Stonham, Heather Milne, David Price, Mark Buchner, Lesley Nelson, Frances S Mair, Aziz Sheikh, Andrew Bush, Brian McKinstry, Hilary Pinnock
pmc-11603350.description: There is uncertainty about how best to diagnose asthma, especially in primary care where mis-diagnosis is common. To address this, we developed a clinical decision support system (CDSS) for asthma diagnosis in children and young people (aged 5-25 years). This study explored the feasibility and acceptability of the CDSS in UK primary care.

pmc-11613625.title: Long-Term Outcomes of Minimally Invasive Endoscopic Versus Sternotomy Surgical Resection of Primary Cardiac Tumors
pmc-11613625.creator: Nader S. Aboelnazar, Brandon R. Loshusan, Michael W. A. Chu
pmc-11613625.description: Objective:Primary cardiac tumors are uncommon, often benign, but can be potentially life threatening. Minimally invasive endoscopic (ENDO) techniques have been shown to be a feasible alternative for tumor resection compared with conventional sternotomy (CS). This study compared the clinical and surgical outcomes of a small series of patients undergoing cardiac tumor resection operations.

pmc-12564311.title: Spectroscopic and Rheological Characterization of Polyvinyl Alcohol/Hyaluronic Acid-Based Systems: Effect of Polymer Ratio and Riboflavin on Hydrogel Properties
pmc-12564311.creator: Iulia Matei, Marius Alexandru Mihai, Sorina-Alexandra Leau, Ludmila Aricov, Anca Ruxandra Leonties, Elvira Alexandrescu, Gabriela Ionita
pmc-12564311.description: We report a systematic investigation on the physicochemical properties of polymer systems consisting of polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) and hyaluronic acid (HA) mixed in various volume ratios (1/4, 2/3, 1/1, 3/2, and 4/1). At PVA/HA ratios above 1/1, in the presence of glutaraldehyde and divinyl sulfone as crosslinking agents, hydrogels are formed.

pmc-12713207.title: Visible yet Invisible: embodied meanings of weight stigma among women with binge eating disorder and higher weight
pmc-12713207.creator: Kjersti Hognes Berg, Eli Natvik, Lisbeth Jahren, Trine Tetlie Eik-Nes
pmc-12713207.description: PurposeHow the body is experienced in the context of weight stigma is largely unexplored among women with binge eating disorder (BED) and higher weight. The aim of this study was to investigate how weight stigma can manifest as embodied meaning.MethodsEight patients participated in qualitative interviews. The data analysis was inspired by Van Manen’s hermeneutic phenomenological method.

pmc-13346666.title: Enhancing privacy preservation and integrity in IoT-enabled wireless sensor networks through novel advanced cryptographic techniques
pmc-13346666.creator: Halima Sadia, Taj Rahman, Asif Rahim, Inayat Khan, Najeeb Ullah, Shabbab Ali Algamdi
pmc-13346666.description: This study presents a novel hybrid cryptographic model designed to enhance privacy preservation and data integrity in IoT-enabled Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). Traditional algorithms such as RSA, AES, and Blowfish are evaluated and combined into a Hybrid Model to address the resource-constrained nature of IoT devices.

pmc-13499119.description: Background and AimsThough topical corticosteroids have long been used for the treatment of eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE), real-world data for the recently Food and Drug Administration–approved budesonide oral suspension (BOS) are lacking. We sought to determine the efficacy of BOS in a real-world cohort of EoE patients.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective cohort study of patients with EoE who were treated with BOS.
